title: Chippewa Valley Schools Policies
description: Research and source links concerning Chippewa Valley Schools policies.
body: The U.S. Department of Education [is investigating](https://web.archive.org/web/20260914035351/https:/www.ed.gov/about/news/press-release/us-department-of-education-opens-three-new-investigations-michigan-school-districts-alleged-title-ix-violations) the district for potential violations of Title IX by allowing boys to participate on girls’ sports teams and use locker rooms based on self-professed gender identities.
